claims.statement: On a writ of habeas corpus, Judge Perkins of the Kenton Criminal Court reduced Tom Allen's bail from the Covington Mayor's figure to $3,000.
claims.excerpt: the court reduced the bail to the latter sum.

claims.statement: D.D. Farrell and Wilson J. Farrell were accepted as sureties, and Tom Allen was released from custody in Covington.
claims.excerpt: were accepted as sureties, and Allen was released.

claims.statement: After his release Tom Allen left Covington for Cincinnati in a carriage with three friends.
claims.excerpt: left Covington for Cincinnati in a carrisge With three of his triends.

claims.statement: Tom Allen made the rounds of the Cincinnati hotels and then went into a saloon on Vine Street near Fourth Street while crowds waited outside.

notes: No fight in this item. Dated 11 September from the Cincinnati Gazette report of 'yesterday' (the Gazette issue date is not printed, so the release date is taken as 11 September). The 'other' claims paraphrase Allen's own statements; none are direct speech.
